AgentSpecs.description: Settings for the Agent Specs content workspace view.

UserAgent.description: The User-Agent header sent when requesting a page as an agent. When empty, a default identifying this package and its version is used (Crumpled.AgentSpecs/<version> (+https://github.com/CrumpledDog/Crumpled.AgentSpecs)). Set this if your WAF or bot rules need to recognise or allow-list the request.

TimeoutSeconds.description: How long, in seconds, to wait for the page before giving up.

MaxBodyBytes.description: The largest response body to read, in bytes (default 8 MiB). A larger response is cut off and flagged as truncated.
